opening.argument: The presentation is framed as a live Avalanche Summit London talk about bringing traditional business activity onchain. The speaker explains Inversion’s operational thesis: acquire traditional businesses, move their functions onto crypto infrastructure, and make them more efficient. He also gives a financial example, discussing acquisition prices and a possible banking valuation. Those claims describe a business strategy and its proposed economics, not an offer requiring the audience to participate. In the supplied material, there is no request for viewers to invest money, send credentials, pay a fee, or join a guaranteed-return scheme. The financial discussion remains part of a conference presentation about how the proposed business model would work.

citations.quote: Live at Avalanche Summit London, Santiago Santos Roel, Founder of Inversion, explores Inversion’s approach to bringing real GDP onchain
